verdict.rationale: Adyen documents public APIs that touch risk management: the Referrals API automates uploads to block and trust lists, the Disputes API handles dispute retrieval and defense, and risk results come back in payment responses. An official OpenAPI definitions repo also exists. However, the evidence shows core operations such as configuring risk profiles and rules, and reviewing cases, done in the Customer Area UI rather than through an API. The docs-site OpenAPI probe paths returned 404. Missing for 10: documented API control of risk profiles and custom rules, API-driven case management review, a hosted OpenAPI spec for the risk endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use our Referrals API to automate uploading lists of referrals and referral details to block and trust lists.
You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.
You can include risk information, such as whether a payment was sent to case management, and which risk rules triggered in these webhooks, as well as in the payment response.
we recommend you use Postman to import the API definition and create your personal collection of requests.
